name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at VWAP ± 2 standard deviations with order flow
why: Stops cluster just beyond VWAP ± 2 standard deviations; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md).

scan.when: flow && vsd > 0 && ((hi(5,1) > lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) < lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) >= a*vsum(5,1)) || (lo(5,1) < lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) > lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) <= -a*vsum(5,1)))
scan.dir: (lo(5,1) < lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) > lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) <= -a*vsum(5,1)) - (hi(5,1) > lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) < lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && dsum(5,1) >= a*vsum(5,1))
